title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 80 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 80 - Tax Averaging (1) If the total income of any member of an association of individual or any partner in a firm includes share income attributable to the association of individual or, as the case may be, the firm, tax calculated at the average rate shall not be payable on the said share income. (2) The average rate of tax shall be calculated according to the following formula, namely: t = a x (b/c) , where— t = tax at average rate, a = tax calculated on total income (including share income of an association of individual or firm), b = share income received from firm or association of individual, c = Total income including share income received from firm or an association of individual.
